items.title: LiveGrab - 'Support the Developer' coffee screen
items.description: A white LiveGrab sheet with a line illustration of a developer at a laptop and 'Support the Developer - Completely optional. Every coffee goes into building LiveGrab.' A gentle donation moment.

items.title: RIVALS - step battle between Finn and Jake
items.description: A dark-green 'RIVALS' screen: smiley crest, For you/Friends tabs, 'Who hits more steps? 4h left' with Finn (+783, 9,204 steps) vs Jake (8,421). A social step duel.

items.title: Match prediction - Turkey vs Australia with a live odds chart
items.description: A dark sports screen: stadium hero with Sports chip, 'Will Turkey or Australia win today's match?' ($230,895 volume, Jun 19 12:00pm PDT), Australia 58% / Turkey 42% line chart and TODAY/1W/1M/ALL tabs. A prediction-market card.

items.title: Three-step setup - details, email code, earn-local-cash
items.description: A dark onboarding trio: 'Let's get you set up' (Date of birth, Legal name, Continue), 'Please enter the code sent to tgrant+demoentryx@example.test' with a keypad, and 'Earn Local Cash in your neighborhood' with Get started. A KYC-to-earn flow.

items.title: React Native Reanimated 4.7 - dot-matrix release notes
items.description: A dark release screen: 'REACT-NATIVE-REANIMATED' with a big dot-matrix '4.7', then 'CSS Transitions - More properties animated natively on Android' and 'Layout Animations - New engine by default'. A version announcement.

items.title: Misha Now - dark biography with portrait and experience
items.description: A dark bio screen: a rendered portrait of a man in shirt and tie, 'Misha Now - Software designer focused on AI-native products. 2x Telegram Contest winner', and Experience ('Member of Technical Staff at Sber - building Russian multimodal AI...'). A portfolio biography.

items.title: AI quick actions - voice chat, create image, write or edit
items.description: A black card listing 'Start a voice chat', 'Create an image' and 'Write or edit' above a blurred orb input. An assistant quick-actions moment.

items.title: Contact reach - 52 accounts binned by days since contact
items.description: A dark CRM screen: '52 accounts' with recency bars (Last 7 days 8, 8-30 days 14, 31-90 days 19, 90+ days/never 11), '30 of 52 accounts haven't been contacted in over 30 days.', a /act reach chip and an Ask anything bar. A relationship-reach board, not settings.

items.title: 'Your Taste Rocks' - dark poster of dot clusters and a barcode
items.description: A near-black frame with a loading spinner beside a 'Your Taste Rocks' poster: scattered pink/white dot clusters, a hexagon mark and a barcode footer. A taste-summary poster reveal.

items.title: Ask Aurelius - ride-stretch question over a dark ask bar
items.description: A dark thread: 'You 4:05 PM - What stretches do I need before ride?' above an 'Ask Aurelius' input with clip and mic icons and a 'Write with Siri' row. A cycling-assistant moment.

items.title: Alien Artifacts - meteorite cards and a glyph-grid poster
items.description: Three screens: a cream 'MIL 15307,5' meteorite specimen card, a black 'Alien Artifacts' poster with a glyph grid, and a list of artifacts with rock photos and prices ($2,400,000,000). A meteorite-collection app, not a calendar set.

items.title: In-hand landscape phone - red 3D bloom with a colour rail
items.description: A hand holds a landscape phone over a desk: a red 3D flower/sculpture on white with a vertical colour-palette rail and a red record dot. A creative-canvas moment in context.
